content.text:
Submitted (status: deviation, preferred level).

- Reverted the 21.3 edit entirely — the original "undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages" sentence stands byte-for-byte and is mapped as already met; its qualifiers that keep disputed and non-conforming amounts inside the limitation are preserved in our favour.
- Single remaining operation on 21.1: cap basis reset to "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", curing the illusory USD 12,000 "Fees"/first-Order-Form base and the event anchor. Mutuality, 21.2's damages exclusion, and all Excluded Claims carve-outs remain untouched.
